Name: Pandaborn - Factions
Description: Early development build. Adds the Inkpaws, a playable giant panda faction with their own buildings, crops, dishes and afternoon rituals: bamboo poles, rice paddies, tea at the Teahouse, naps, and a rested bonus for a short working day. A Moon Loft invites the Ringtails, red pandas who work from the afternoon bell to dawn. Flumes and the Lantern Festival come in later versions. Art and code are AI-generated.
